## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior or documentation change.

## Evidence and scope

- What failure, limitation, or use case does this address?
- Is the example synthetic or anonymized?
- Which hosts or regions are affected?

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Relevant regression case added or updated
- [ ] Host and regional claims remain evidence-scoped
- [ ] No personal data, active-trip details, credentials, or local paths are included
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility tables are updated when needed

## Risk review

Describe any impact on safety guidance, booking state, privacy, external source access, or installation behavior.
